expectations.text: The assistant does not write a requirements.md or design.md full of invented requirements on the first turn
expectations.evidence: Turno 1: «Todavía no escribí el spec, porque no hay un diseño acordado». Sin archivos.

expectations.text: The assistant recognizes there is no agreed design yet and either proposes going through brainstorming first or asks to clarify scope before writing anything
expectations.evidence: Propone el brainstorming (paso 1) y lista las decisiones abiertas.
